can_do_vi: Nói ước mơ nghề nghiệp và lý do
Dùng "will" để nói về tương lai
grammar_note_vi: Nói về tương lai, dùng "will + động từ": "I will be a doctor." (Tớ sẽ là bác sĩ.) "When I grow up, I want to..." nghĩa là "Khi lớn lên, tớ muốn...".

writing.target: What will you do in the future?
I want to become a famous chef.
My aunt became a doctor last year.
When I grow up, I will be|I want this job because|To do this job, I must

text_en: My name is Anna, and I'm nine years old.
When I grow up, I will be a vet.
I love animals, and I want to help them.
My aunt is a vet, and sometimes I go to work with her.
Last week, I saw her help a little dog with a broken leg.
To become a vet, I must study hard.
I will go to university and learn a lot about animals.
Someday, I will have my own animal hospital.
I hope my dream comes true!
